scope: Pure TagDuel LP-cost adapter for Chain Energy; no central resolver, catalog, certification, inventory or player-data mutation.

card.name: Chain Energy
card.officialEffect: Each player must pay 500 Life Points per card to Normal Summon, Special Summon, Set or activate cards from his/her respective hand.

rulings.handEffects: OCG rulings include effects activated from the hand (e.g. Kuriboh/Thunder Dragon) and Special Summons from the hand by card effects; the activation and the later hand summon are separate charge events.
rulings.alreadySet: Cards already Set on the field and cards placed onto the field by another effect are not treated as cards played from the hand for this cost.
rulings.cost: The 500 LP is a cost, not effect damage, and does not start a Chain Link.
rulings.multipleCopies: The adapter treats each active, non-negated face-up copy as an independent continuous cost source; verify in engine integration before certification.

design.perCard: 500 LP per card from hand, per active copy. Multi-card hand summons/sets scale by card count.
design.team: LP is charged from the shared team pool; the action must belong to the current physical member, and the exact card UIDs must be in that member's private active hand.
design.privacy: The output plan exposes only card count and public Chain Energy source UIDs, never the identities or UIDs of private hand cards.
design.timing: Cost plan is emitted before the action; no LP is mutated by the adapter.
design.exclusions: No cost for cards from Deck, GY, Extra Deck, field, banished zone; no cost for discarding/sending/revealing a card as an effect cost.

plannedTests: Normal/Special Summon, Set and activate Spell/Trap/monster effect from hand
multi-card hand actions and multiple active copies
both teams, shared LP, active physical seat and private-hand UID ownership
separate activation-from-hand and later Special Summon-from-hand cost events
no charge for field/already-Set, Deck, GY, Extra, banished, discard, send-to-GY or reveal
face-down/negated sources, insufficient LP and exact-zero payment
stale LP, wrong member, duplicate UID, malformed card type and duplicate action receipt
privacy-preserving plan and full TagDuel immutability
